description: HTML file containing embedded JavaScript for WebUSB serial communication sample application, including functions for device connection, data transfer, and UI interaction.

classes.name: serial.Port
classes.description: Represents a WebUSB serial port with methods to connect, disconnect, and send data.

methods.name: serial.getPorts
methods.description: Retrieves connected USB devices and wraps them into serial.Port instances.

methods.name: serial.requestPort
methods.description: Requests user to select a USB device matching specified filters and creates a serial.Port.

methods.name: serial.Port.prototype.connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the USB device and starts reading data.

methods.name: serial.Port.prototype.disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection to the USB device.

methods.name: serial.Port.prototype.send
methods.description: Sends data to the USB device.
